title: Sri Ranganathaswamy Temple and its Rajagopuram, Srirangam
summary: The Sri Ranganathaswamy Temple at Srirangam, near Tiruchirappalli, has a 13-tiered Rajagopuram that Guinness World Records gives as at least 72 m high. Begun under Achyuta Deva Raya, it was not finished until 1987, under the guidance of the Ahobila Mutt. The temple itself is described as over a thousand years old.

uncertainty.note: Start is the beginning of the reign of Achyuta Deva Raya (1529-1542) under whom the gopuram was begun, per Live History India; the exact start of work is not given. The gopuram was completed and consecrated on 25 March 1987. The temple itself is said to be over a thousand years old, which this record does not date. End is the present.
